about_the_game:
Overview
Turn n’ Run is a turn-based party platformer for up to 6 players, where every turn is a chance to jump, shove and roll through outrageous obstacle courses inspired by Gladiators, Ninja Warrior and Total Wipeout.

Game Details
Every match is a fast-paced spectacle, split across three wildly different stages:

  • The Maze – Grab items and outsmart rivals as you navigate twists, turns and traps.
  • The Gauntlet – Test your platforming skills with jumps, leaps and dodges. One slip can send you flying to the abyss.
  • The Roll to the Goal – Climb into a giant sphere and race to the finish, colliding with opponents along the way.

Matches are procedurally generated, so no two shows are ever the same.
With a mix of strategy, daring moves and pure chaos, every turn is unpredictable—and hilarious.

Key Features

  • Turn-based party fun for 2–6 players, local or online
  • Three-stage obstacle courses blending mazes, platforming and giant spheres
  • Items and power-ups to boost yourself or sabotage friends
  • Procedurally generated courses for endless variety
  • Colourful, stylised visuals and tongue-in-cheek game show humour
  • Family-friendly gameplay full of laughter, chaos and competitive thrills

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Saturday Night TV is back! Kick it old-skool with Turn n’ Run, a turn-based party platformer for up to 6 players. Turn by turn you can conquer the maze, survive the platforming gauntlets, and roll it to the goal in giant spheres. Shove and outshine your rivals under the TV spotlights.
